title: com.docker.sandbox/agent-interactive-sessions@1
description: The workload's interactive session control surface: the argv shapes a human-facing host uses to put the agent's terminal UI in front of a person. prompt, resume, continue, newSession, and sessionPicker are argv tails appended to the launch command and run with a terminal attached; list is a complete command whose stdout enumerates resumable session ids, one per line, most recent first. Every verb is optional, but at least one must be declared. A present key means the verb is supported and an absent key means it is not, except newSession, which defaults to the lifecycle@1 interactive launch; a present empty list means the launch argv alone.

prompt.description: Argv tail that starts an interactive session seeded with a prompt; must reference {{.Prompt}}, which the host substitutes before execution.

resume.description: Argv tail that reopens a named session interactively; must reference {{.SessionID}}.

continue.description: Argv tail that reopens the most recent session interactively.

newSession.description: Argv tail that starts a fresh interactive session with no prompt. Often empty: the launch argv alone. When omitted, a new session starts as lifecycle@1's interactive launch does. When the Kit also declares lifecycle's interactive tail, the two must be the same argv.

sessionPicker.description: Argv tail that starts the agent on its own session picker.

list.description: Complete command (string run via sh -c, or argv list) whose stdout is one resumable session id per line, most recent first. The same command, with the same meaning, as agent-sessions@1's list, but a present list must name a command: neither an empty string nor an empty list.
